summary_of_theorems.T1_sharp_free_support_bound_and_column_p: max(1, s - m) <= s_F <= min(s, n - m), and unique plants with s >= 3 are immune to unit/column-pair collisions in sparse_column_attack.
summary_of_theorems.T2_conditional_LLL_bound_not_determinant: For a VERIFIED (delta,eta)-reduced basis, alpha=1/(delta-eta^2). The lambda2 isolation criterion is conditional; no growing lambda2 or LLL success follows from determinant alone.
summary_of_theorems.T3_projective_free_coordinate_rref_searc: Projective enumeration over u_F in {-1, 0, 1}^(n-m) \ {0} checks exactly (3^(n-m) - 1)/2 states without an exponential table, using O(m*(n-m)+n) additional integer slots. State counts do not certify wall-time dominance over MITM.
